purpose: Include every member of a named category emphatically.
keywords: Every field was covered in snow.
Every shelf is packed with documents.
We searched every road, but the dog was nowhere to be found.
restrictions: The noun is repeated; this is different from naming something with という.
mistake: Do not omit the repeated noun or interpret this as a reported quotation.

segments.role: Include every member of a named category emphatically. N + という + same N
